events.description: Come join us at High-Hand Brewery to hear a live performance by The Used Cars. Step into a nostalgic journey through the iconic sounds of the 80s new wave synth-pop era with The Used Cars. Keeping the spirit of The Cars alive, this dynamic band faithfully delivers all the hits from the 1978 eponymous album to the 1984 release of Heartbeat City. With dual lead singers expertly channeling the essence of Ric Ocasek and Benjamin Orr, The Used Cars create an authentic experience that might make you believe you’re listening to the original legends. Their genuine passion for the music propels them to infuse an extra dose of magic into every performance, ensuring a night on the dance floor that’s exactly what you’ve been craving. You can learn more about them by clicking here to visit their website . Only guests 18 and older may attend our “On Stage” concerts.

events.description: Rogue is a powerhouse four-piece hard rock band that has anchored the Sacramento and regional Northern California music scene for nearly three decades. Known for their heavy, driving energy, the band delivers an explosive mix of original music and classic rock covers that consistently packs regional venues. The group features the powerful, blues-infused lead vocals of Randy Scoles (known for his work with the Ronnie Montrose Band), founding bassist Nick Nichols, and thunderous drummer Bobby Contreras, with renowned regional guitarist Billy Raney (formerly of the Frank Hannon Band) now fueling the band’s fierce guitar attack. events.title: On Stage with The Nitwits
events.description: Introducing The Nitwits, a powerhouse cover band dedicated to keeping the spirit of classic rock and 80’s pop alive! With Bryan shredding on the lead guitar, Bobby laying down the funky bass lines, Beth adding layers of lush soundscapes on keyboards, Lynda belting out iconic vocals, Eric bringing the rhythm guitar and soulful vocals, and Caleb keeping the beat on drums, this band is a force to be reckoned with. But The Nitwits are more than just a group of talented musicians – they are a tribute to a dear friend who left this world too soon. With each performance, they honor his memory and his love for music. What sets The Nitwits apart is their commitment to giving back. They donate the majority of their earnings to the Mr. Holland’s Opus Foundation, ensuring that future generations have access to music education and opportunities. So when you rock out with The Nitwits, you’re not just enjoying great music – you’re making a difference. Join The Nitwits on a journey through the greatest hits of decades past, and experience the magic of music that transcends time. Only guests 18 and older may attend our “On Stage” concerts.

events.description: Come join us at High-Hand Brewery to hear a live performance by The Frat Boys. They are a Rocklin, CA based band playing Vintage Rock and Roll music from the 50s/60s/70s. Composed of five accomplished musicians, the Frat Boys have been making a grand entrance into the Greater Sacramento music scene, covering favorites from Elvis, Chuck Berry, Beatles, Rolling Stones and Kinks to Eagles, Free, Bad Company and Aerosmith … and more. A high-energy performance dance band, the Frat Boys Rock the House! Only guests 18 and older may attend our “On Stage” concerts.
